name: 13-merge-messages-strict-placeholders
description: strict + placeholders, case: messages[0] is NOT a user turn and not a system turn -- a leading assistant turn, followed by a user turn. The :946-947 branch unshifts the placeholder in FRONT of the assistant turn, so the merged array becomes [user(placeholder), assistant, user], and only then does the recursion at :950 run with strict:false / single:false / tools:false and return a fresh array. Pinning the placeholder's position (index 0, not index 1) is the point: the :944 branch would have put it at index 1 after a leading system turn, and the two branches are one character apart in the reference.
